_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Writing the guide and workbook in Metodic…

description: Make the session's PRINT PACKAGE with Metodic's real generators and hand back PDF downloads: the FACILITATOR GUIDE (the script for the day: what to say, timing, what to watch for) and the PARTICIPANT WORKBOOK (one booklet per participant with every activity's pages). The same generators and prices as the app: 0.2 credit each, free when one already exists. Takes 1-2 minutes when they still have to be written. Do not write a guide or workbook yourself.

regenerate.description: Only when the user explicitly wants NEW versions. Left out, existing ones are reused for free.
